explanation: Ball falls with vx=-3.24 moving left past thin wall (x=14,w=0.3 so right face 14.3, top y=8.3). It grazes the top-right corner: step22 distance +0.098 (just outside), step23 distance -0.051 (light penetration, no bounce — vx,vy continue ballistic), step24 distance -0.200 beyond 0.15 limit. Velocity never reflects, so the corner contact produced no impulse and positional correction did not push it out; penetration grows each step. Likely cause: corner/side normal selection or contact resolution fails for a fast oblique graze on a thin box despite 5-6 substeps, letting the circle sink into the side face.
vision_note: The red ball drops onto the top tip of the thin vertical wall while drifting slightly left to center over it. By step 24 it sits intersecting the wall tip instead of bouncing or rolling off to the side.
